title: The matching bill
change: manifest.json is the August manifest with one hex digit of its signature changed (the first). bill.json is the matching bill with `manifest` re-pointed to that altered manifest's record hash. Receipts, keys and everything else are the fixture's.
why: Only the manifest's signature is wrong: the receipts verify and link, the manifest still fixes the same set, and the bill names the manifest it was given. A consumer that checks links but never checks a signature passes this bill; so far no case among the 11 separates such a consumer by verdict or decisive claim.
